reader_summary.overview: Carla Harris is a Senior Client Advisor at Morgan Stanley. She is the author of three books about navigating careers and leadership, Expect to Win , Strategize to Win , and the upcoming Lead to Win . She's also an accomplished gospel singer who has sold out shows in Carnegie Hall and the Apollo Theatre.

key_points.text: Carla Harris is a Senior Client Advisor at Morgan Stanley.
She is the author of three books about navigating careers and leadership, Expect to Win , Strategize to Win , and the upcoming Lead to Win .
Our conversation offers Carla's pearls of wisdom in navigating a career from her earliest days on the Street.
